data.one_liner: Helpers to convert Dart objects to/from Map and JSON without code generation.
data.what_it_does: cv provides a lightweight way to define models with fields and convert them to maps or JSON. It supports nested models, lists, maps, dates, enums and multi‑type fields, all without code generation.
use_when: You need quick, mutable models that map to JSON or Map for local storage or API payloads.
You want to avoid build_runner or codegen tooling for simple data structures.
You need to handle null and unset values explicitly in your models.
avoid_when: Your data models are large and complex, requiring performance optimisations or immutability.
You rely heavily on code generation for type safety and boilerplate reduction (e.g., freezed).
strengths: Easy to register and use models
Handles null/unset values and type conversions
weaknesses: Models are mutable, which may not fit all architectures
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, register constructors with cvAddConstructor or cvAddConstructors before converting maps or JSON.
